BiblicalUsage: Aridai appears once, in the same list as his brothers, one of the ten sons of Haman hanged after the Jews defended themselves. Like the others, he is named and nothing more is said.
TheologicalSignificance: Ten names, ten hangings, one judgment: the house that rose against God's people fell together, and Scripture keeps the count.
